loop_primitives.evidence_quote: OSS-Fuzz-Gen organizes multiple agents into three stages executed in a pipeline
loop_primitives.note: Feedback cycle: generate driver, fuzz it, analyze, refine.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: We omit planning and memory modules since frontier LLMs provide them implicitly.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: passing outputs directly to the next stage

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: each agent isolated in a container and managed by a central orchestrator
human_in_loop.note: No approval gate described in the pipeline.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: agents operating on the same function write results to a central repository accessible by others
short_term_state.note: Shared Repository Pattern added with the new agents.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: We omit planning and memory modules since frontier LLMs provide them implicitly.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: We implemented acapture-and-replay approach [34] that enables independent execution and debugging of agents.
state_persistence.note: Replay of captured inputs for debugging, not resumption of an interrupted run.

self_verification.evidence_quote: (2)execution stage, where drivers are fuzzed; and (3) analysis stage, where execution results are analyzed and used to guide fuzz driver refinements
self_verification.note: Compiler tool also checks compilability; Crash Analyzer/Crash Validator are LLM judges.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: each trial generating and iterating on a fuzz driver for up to five cycles

rollback.evidence_quote: each agent isolated in a container and managed by a central orchestrator
rollback.note: No undo/revert mechanism described; drivers are regenerated rather than rolled back.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: the system integrates a feedback cycle, stopping after (1) a true positive bug; (2) a maximum number of cycles; or (3) a coverage plateau.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Together, these agents increase OSS-Fuzz-Gen API cost by about 9.31%
cost_controls.note: Costs measured but no budget/caching/routing mechanism described.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Each driver was executed for five minutes in the execution stage.
timeouts.note: Fuzzing run time limit; no run-level wall-clock timeout described.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: It runs on Google’s distributed cloud infrastructure, with each agent isolated in a container

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Our approach gives the LLM flexibility to issue commands within an isolated environment.
